sentences.text:
In the matter of : Digam @ Digambar Mahato  .... Appellant  Mr. Satya Ranjan Kundu  ...for the Appellant  1.
Appellant is represented by the learned advocate.
3. It is candidly submitted by the learned advocate for the appellant that presently he has not contact with this appellant.

4. This instant appeal is preferred challenging the impugned judgment and order of conviction dated 14.6.2005 passed by the learned Trial Court wherein this appellant is found guilty for commission of the offence under Section 376 of IPC and was sentenced to suffer R.I. for seven years along with fine and, in default of payment of fine to suffer R.I. for further six months.
5.
An application for bail was taken out by this appellant on 27.7.2005 and his prayer for bail was rejected by this Court.
6. As the State is not represented, learned Public Prosecutor of this Court is hereby requested to appoint an advocate from the empanelled list to represent the State in this case.
7. Department is directed to communicate this order to the office of the learned Public Prosecutor of this Court.

8. State is directed to obtain a report from the correctional home as to whether this appellant/convict has already served out the sentence as directed by the learned Trial Court in the impugned judgment and order on the date fixed.
